item.stem:
The diagram shows Esha keeping the metal point fixed at E with the compass open to a fixed length, and moving only the pencil.

What path does the pencil draw?

options.A: A circle with centre E, and with every pencil point at the same fixed distance from E.
options.B: A circle whose radius is the point E.
options.C: A circle with centre at the moving pencil tip, and with E on the rim.
options.D: A triangle that has one vertex fixed at E.
